name: Tou Yue Jiao Cang
overview: Orphan Lin Shuyue, trained as a gambling prodigy by the Shen family, loses her memory after a chaotic engagement banquet and is rescued by Xie Lin, who impersonates her lost love to uncover family secrets. As they unite to exact revenge on the Shen family, their forced deception grows into genuine love, culminating in justice and personal redemption.
